acceptance_card.title: Averaged inverter control response
acceptance_card.summary: Simulate a balanced dq LCL inverter with cascaded voltage/current PI control, vector limits, back-calculation anti-windup, and a refined RK4 trace.

equations: L_f·d i_f/dt = u_inv − v_c − R_f i_f + ωL_f J i_f; C_f·d v_c/dt = i_f − i_g − i_load + ωC_f J v_c; L_g·d i_g/dt = v_c − v_grid − R_g i_g + ωL_g J i_g, with J=[[0,1],[-1,0]].
i_ref = sat_I(i_g+i_load+K_pv(v_ref−v_c)+K_iv∫(v_ref−v_c)dt); u_inv = sat_V(v_c+K_pi(i_ref−i_f)+K_ii∫(i_ref−i_f)dt). Integrators use back-calculation from each vector-limit residual.
The averaged two-level inverter voltage bound is Vdc·m_max/√3. State derivatives are integrated with fixed-step RK4 at dt and dt/2; aligned trajectories are compared as a numerical refinement check.
limitations: Balanced positive-sequence dq averaged plant; the grid angle is imposed at the nominal frequency. There is no PLL state or synchronization transient.
No PWM switching ripple, dead time, sample/computation delay, sensor filters, DC-link dynamics, unbalance, harmonics, protection, or grid-code behavior is modeled.
The fixed-step RK4 model and local linearization are software research screens, not a calibrated controller, hardware result, field validation, or service qualification.

acceptance_card.title: Closed-loop inverter eigenmodes
acceptance_card.summary: Linearize the unsaturated averaged LCL and cascaded PI model at its grid-voltage equilibrium, then report actual state-matrix eigenvalues and modal damping ratios.

equations: Compute the local matrix A by central-difference linearization of the same ten-state averaged plant/controller used by hybrid-controls at its unsaturated zero-load equilibrium; i_f,q=ωC_fV_grid,d supplies synchronous capacitor current, and PI integrators supply the balancing equilibrium outputs.
λ_k are computed from A; local asymptotic stability requires max Re(λ_k)<0. The reported damping ratio is −Re(λ_k)/|λ_k|, and is a local linear modal quantity only.
limitations: Balanced positive-sequence dq averaged plant; the grid angle is imposed at the nominal frequency. There is no PLL state or synchronization transient.

This is the unsaturated local model at an equilibrium; current and modulation limit nonlinearities are inactive. It is not a large-disturbance stability guarantee.
